proposal.friction: Agents can treat successful creation and topology analysis as completion without explicitly comparing returned bounds, dimensions, and pose to the request. One curved-panel run claimed completion but its independently evaluated saved file failed; the available evidence does not establish a plugin geometry defect. Repeated guidance reads (8 charged calls across 4 runs) make concise, generic verification guidance worth testing, but are not themselves defects.
evidence: Observation: the curved-panels run claimed completion but its saved-file verdict was fail; creation and analysis reportedly returned the geometry that was actually produced.
Observation: get_modeling_guidance incurred 8 charged discovery calls across posed-solids, trimmed-patches, curved-panels, and editing-existing; 4 occurred in trimmed-patches.
Observation: 78 baseline calls had zero failed calls and eight of nine tasks passed; this does not support a general plugin-operation failure.
Limitation: all historical sessions are comparison-ineligible because resolved model/version and paired, repeated baseline/candidate conditions are not pinned.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded, description-only update to existing generic modeling/verification guidance that tells agents to compare observed returned measurements (bounds, requested dimensions, and pose) with task requirements before declaring completion will improve saved-file task success or reduce unnecessary verification/discovery calls without increasing failed calls. It will not be treated as evidence that a Rhino plugin operation caused the curved-panel failure.
preserve: Keep agent model recipe, task prompts, evaluator, call budget, timeout, host environment, and acceptance criteria fixed within each baseline/candidate comparison.
Use two AB/BA pairs with pinned gpt-5.6-terra medium, 50-call budget, and 240-second timeout; no retries.
Run a fixed Claude Sonnet medium baseline/candidate pilot and require no task-success or failed-tool-call regression before retaining any description change.
Require every candidate saved-file task to pass, no per-family correctness or failed-call regression, and benefit in at least one discovery family; otherwise reject.
Do not claim measured improvement from this audit.
Description-only server-side scope: no plugin, protocol/schema, executable AST, scripts, macros, evaluator, promotion, merge, or publication changes.
Treat curve-network-joining as planned held-out validation only; it was absent from the supplied audit.

review: Explicit supervisor dispatch for a server description hypothesis, not a diagnosed C# defect. No held-out parameters disclosed.
